content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Post graduate degree in Public Health (MPH)/ M.Sc. Epidemiology/M.Sc. Health Economics from a recognized institution. Experience in health economics/health technology assessment in recognized institute(s). Knowledge of Computer Applications/Data Management. The age limit printed for the Research Assistant post is 35 years. The notice does not specify the date on which age is counted or any age relaxation. Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and in a reputed institution/organization. The experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. Qualification, experience, other terms and conditions may be relaxed/altered at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. If the number of applications is very large, more stringent criteria than those specified may be used to determine eligibility. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Assistant gets a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 50,000/- per month, and no other allowances are payable. The notice adds that the consolidated salary of the post may vary from time to time and that no other allowance or facilities other than the consolidated salary shall be extended.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Research Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice states that a Research Assistant will be appointed at every partner institute during the period of data collection. The duties are: Perform interviews for data collection in accordance with the Research topic. Any other work assigned by the Department of Health Research.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only by email. The notice gives these instructions: Fill in the prescribed application form attached to the notice. Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. Scan the filled form along with the CV and supporting documents into one PDF. Name the PDF file as "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application" (the notice's example: "James_DEO_2023_application"). Write the name of the post applied for in the email subject line. Email the PDF to [email protected] so that it is received by 28.11.2026, 1.00 PM. To apply for two or more different posts, fill a separate application form for each post and send it with the necessary enclosures in separate emails. Filled application form in the prescribed format Two-page CV Recent photograph Supporting documents and certificates (documentary proof) Applications with a CV alone and without the prescribed form and certificates will be rejected. Incomplete applications, applications not in the prescribed format and those not fulfilling the essential criteria are likely to be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted based on the details furnished in the application, CV and the documentary proof provided; the decision of the selection committee will be final in this regard. The final selection will be based on the CV, application and interview. The terms and conditions also state that only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview, and that the decision of the Project Investigator will be final. Topics: Research Methodology, Basic Epidemiology, clinical research and Communication skills. Mode: in person or via videoconferencing, at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. For a video interview, the candidate must arrange a suitable device (computer/ laptop/ mobile) with audio and camera facilities and an adequate internet connection. Date: tentatively scheduled for the first week of December 2026; the exact date will be notified to shortlisted applicants through email. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Assistant vacancies has JIPMER advertised?
faq.answer: JIPMER has advertised 2 Research Assistant posts in the Department of Preventive and Social Medicine under Advertisement No. JIP/PSM/HTAIn/37/26.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JIPMER Research Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The filled application must be received by email by 28 November 2026, 1.00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the JIPMER Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a post graduate degree in Public Health (MPH)/ M.Sc. Epidemiology/M.Sc. Health Economics from a recognized institution. Experience in health economics/health technology assessment and knowledge of Computer Applications/Data Management are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the JIPMER Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The age limit printed in the notice for the Research Assistant post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a JIPMER Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 50,000/- per month, and no other allowances are payable.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the JIPMER Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Email the filled prescribed application form with your CV and supporting documents, scanned in one PDF named "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", to [email protected], with the post name in the subject line.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Applicants will be shortlisted on the application, CV and documentary proof, and the final selection will be based on the CV, application and interview covering Research Methodology, Basic Epidemiology, clinical research and Communication skills.

faq.question: Q8. When will the JIPMER Research Assistant interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview is tentatively scheduled for the first week of December 2026, in person or via videoconferencing, and the exact date will be emailed to shortlisted applicants.

faq.question: Q9. Is the JIPMER Research Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely on contract basis for an externally sponsored project with a likely duration of 11 months, and the person engaged will have no claim to any regular post in JIPMER.

faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
